company.name: Chocablock Chocolates
company.distributes: Branded chocolate (Lindt, Cadbury, Toblerone, Ferrero Rocher, Maltesers), sweets (Pascall, Skittles, Trolli, Chupa Chups, Mentos), biscuits (Arnott's, Tim Tam, Biscoff) and snacks (Pringles) in personalised packs
what_they_do_well: Australian owned and operated for over ten years, claiming more than 130,000 customers served Australia-wide.
company.fit_rationale: Sells a wide spread of other companies' branded chocolate, sweets, biscuits and snacks, personalised for corporate gifting, so Diablo's chocolate, biscuits and gift boxes sit in its existing range. A better-for-you option is a natural addition to the brands it already shows. Storage: Moorabbin premises listed; warehouse not named on its website.
